title: HR & Operations Administrator
description:
Job Title: HR & Operations Administrator

Location: Jewellery Quarter, Birmingham - This position is a 100% office based

Salary: Competitive salary dependent on experience

Job Type: Full Time, Permanent

Working Hours: 40 Hours per week - flexible start and finish times, with our core working hours of 9am to 4pm. Start between 7:30 and 9am and Finish between 4pm and 5:30pm.

About Blue Thorn:

Established in 2002, Blue Thorn Technology is an established and progressive BIM 3 D modelling specialist specialising in building services coordination on major construction projects. We have recently moved to new offices in Birmingham to support our continued growth.

About The Role:

We are looking for an enthusiastic, organised, and proactive HR & Operations Administrator to join our friendly and supportive team. This is a varied role offering exposure to HR, operations, health & safety, and facilities management, making it an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys variety and wants to broaden their business support experience.

Working closely with the Operations/HR Manager and wider management team, you will play a key role in supporting the day-to-day running of the business while helping to deliver an excellent employee experience.

You will be joining a supportive environment where comprehensive on-the-job training will be provided, helping you develop your skills and knowledge across multiple areas of the business.

Key Responsibilities:

Human Resources:
- Supporting the Operations/HR Manager with all aspects of HR administration throughout the employee lifecycle
- Assisting with recruitment activities, including advertising vacancies, arranging interviews, and supporting onboarding processes
- Preparing employment documentation including offer letters, contracts, contractual amendments, and other employee correspondence
- Managing sickness absence administration & meetings
- Responding to employee queries in a professional, confidential, and timely manner
- Maintaining accurate employee records and updating the HR management system
- Conducting Right to Work checks and BPSS security screening checks
- Taking minutes during HR and employee relations meetings
- Monitoring probation reviews and supporting employee development plans
- Assisting with Payroll information preparation

Operations Administration:
- Providing administrative support to operational and management teams
- Coordinating meetings and preparing supporting documentation
- Producing professional company communications, notices, procedures and employee bulletins
- Maintaining company records and supporting compliance activities
- Supporting the implementation and administration of internal systems and processes
- Supporting company events and employee engagement activities
- Maintaining operational trackers and management reports

Health & Safety Administration:
- Supporting the maintenance of Health & Safety records and documentation
- Monitoring mandatory training requirements and compliance records
- Assisting with workplace audits, inspections and risk assessment administration
- Maintaining accident, incident and near-miss records
- Assisting with Health & Safety communications and initiatives
- Helping ensure company policies and records remain up to date and compliant
- Facilities Management Support
- Coordinating office facilities and workplace maintenance activities
- Liaising with contractors, suppliers and service providers
- Supporting office health, safety and security arrangements
- Helping to maintain a safe, organised and professional working environment
- Supporting ad hoc facilities and office management projects

About you:

Essential Requirements:
- Minimum of 18 months' previous HR Administration experience - Previous experience in HR Admin, HR Assistant or Office Admin Role.
- Strong organisational and administrative abilities
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to produce professional company communications and employee correspondence
- Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Word and Excel
- Professional and confidential approach to handling sensitive information
- Positive attitude and willingness to learn
- Friendly, approachable and team-oriented personality
- Excellent attendance and timekeeping record

Desirable Requirements:
- Experience using HR Management Systems
- Experience using SharePoint and Microsoft 365
- Experience supporting Health & Safety administration
- CIPD qualification or studying towards CIPD
- An interest in developing towards an HR Advisor position

Benefits:
- Auto-enrolment pension scheme (after 3 months' service)
- Company sick pay (following successful completion of probation)
- Employee Assistance Programme available 24/7
- Employee Discount Scheme (following successful completion of probation)

Additional Information:

An immediate start is available for the right candidate.

Please note that we are unable to provide Skilled Worker visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK.

If you are looking for a varied role where no two days are the same and want to develop your career within a growing and supportive business, we would love to hear from you.

Please click on the APPLY button to send your CV for this role.

The successful candidate will play an important role in ensuring efficient HR Processes, maintaining compliance records, and supporting smooth day to day running of the business.

Candidates with the experience or relevant job titles of: HR Assistant, Human Resources Assistant, Human Resources Executive, HR Executive, Human Resources Administrator, Operations Amin, Administrative Assistant, Operations Administrator, Office Administrator, Business Administrator, Admin Executive, HR Admin may also be considered for this role.

title: HR Assistant
description:
HR Assistant Part Time

Location: Sparkhill / South Birmingham
Start Date: January 2027
Contract: Temporary to Permanent
Hours: Part-time 22 hours per week (flexible working pattern to be discussed)

About the Role

We are currently recruiting for an organised and proactive HR Assistant to join a busy school environment in the Sparkhill area of Birmingham.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous HR or administration experience who is looking to develop their career within a school setting. The position will initially be offered on a temporary basis, with the opportunity to become permanent for the right candidate.

Working as part of the HR and administration team, you will provide essential support across a range of HR functions, ensuring staff records, recruitment processes and general HR administration are maintained accurately and efficiently.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
- Providing day-to-day HR administrative support to the wider team.
- Maintaining accurate and confidential electronic and paper personnel records.
- Supporting recruitment and selection processes, including arranging interviews and liaising with candidates.
- Preparing offer letters, employment contracts and new starter documentation.
- Assisting with pre-employment checks, including DBS, references and safeguarding checks.
- Processing staff changes, leavers' paperwork and general HR correspondence.
- Maintaining and updating HR databases and staff records.
- Supporting the maintenance of the Single Central Record (SCR).
- Assisting with payroll administration and staff-related documentation.
- Producing letters, reports and meeting minutes as required.
- Providing general administrative support to the wider school team.

The Ideal Candidate
- Previous experience in an HR or administrative role.
- Excellent organisational skills and strong attention to detail.
- Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Word and Excel.
- Experience using databases or HR management systems.
- Able to handle confidential and sensitive information professionally.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Able to manage competing priorities and work effectively in a busy environment.
- Previous experience working within a school or education setting would be advantageous but is not essential.

Additional Information
- Part-time position, 22 hours per week.
- Working hours to be discussed and agreed.
- Temp to perm
- January 2027 start.
- Enhanced DBS and satisfactory references will be required.

Interested?

If you have previous HR or administration experience and are looking for your next opportunity within education, we would love to hear from you. Please apply with your up-to-date CV.

title: Contract Compliance Officer
description:
Since 1899, Birmingham Settlement has been working to create opportunity and choice - connecting and empowering people through action, activities, and shared learning to build and sustain wellbeing for all.

Contract Compliance Officer

Salary: £26,000 pa (dependent on experience, for review following successful completion of probation)

35 hours per week

Based at Birmingham Settlement's Sports & Community Centre, Kingstanding, Birmingham

This is a fantastic opportunity for a highly-skilled, experienced and motivated Administrator to work for our established and highly respected Advice Quality Standard (AQS) accredited Money Advice Service.

As Contract Compliance Officer you will undertake administrative duties to collate data and support the production of service reporting for the Settlement's commissioned Money Advice Services - including the provision of information for Birmingham City Council and the Money and Pensions Service (MaPS).

You will work with the Money Advice Service Manager and Debt & Welfare Benefit Advisors to provide administrative support as required, including receiving and making calls to clients. This will sometimes include helping out with reception duties as required.

The role forms an integral part of the Money Advice Team.

You will be joining a long established and professional Money Advice Service providing specialist advice with a holistic approach that covers all areas of debt and welfare benefit along with financial literacy training to build and continually improve money management and financial capability.

Our Money Advice Team sits within the overall Settlement which provides a wide range of community support services covering all ages and aspects of need, please see our website.

This is a great opportunity to join a progressive charity making a real difference to people's lives.

For an informal discussion about the role call Theresa Gniadkowski.

This is an active recruitment; early applications are encouraged

We reserve the right to close this opportunity early if a successful candidate is appointed prior to the closing date

Why Work for Birmingham Settlement?

At Birmingham Settlement, you're not just taking on a job, you're becoming part of a friendly, values-led organisation that has been making a difference across Birmingham for more than 125 years.

We're proud of our diverse, supportive and collaborative culture. Our teams work closely together across advice, wellbeing, community development, environmental and training services, creating opportunities to learn from one another, share ideas and develop professionally. No two days are ever the same, and you'll have the chance to see first-hand the positive impact your work has on individuals, families and communities.

We recognise that our people are our greatest asset and are committed to creating a workplace where staff feel valued, supported and able to thrive. We offer flexible working arrangements, encourage positive work-life balance, invest in learning and development, and promote wellbeing through a range of staff activities and social opportunities.

Our benefits include:
- 28 days annual leave , increasing with length of service to a maximum of 33 days
- Contributory pension scheme
- Flexible working options
- Free use of our community gym
- Free onsite parking at all of our sites
- Staff wellbeing activities and social events
- Ongoing training and professional development opportunities
- The opportunity to work within a passionate organisation committed to creating opportunity, reducing inequality and building stronger communities

If you're looking for a rewarding role, where you provide essential support an excellent team and make a genuine difference to people's lives, we'd love to hear from you.

inclusive of 3 days annual leave between Christmas and New Year

Please submit your CV with Supporting Statement of no more than 1,000 words to address how you will meet the requirements of the role, please also submit your Equality & Diversity Form you can find it on our web page and email it to us or write to Human Resources, Birmingham Settlement Sports & Community Centre,

600 Kingstanding Road, Kingstanding, Birmingham, B44 9 SH

Closing date for applications: Tuesday 10th November 2026

Interviews: To be confirmed

Birmingham Settlement is committed to Equality of Opportunity and welcomes applications from all sections of the community. Registered charity number 517303

title: HR Coordinator and Onboarding Specialist
company: Orion Electrotech - Engineering & Technical - Agency - Temporary
description:
HR Coordinator & Onboarding Specialist (Fixed-Term Contract)

Solihull, Birmingham (Hybrid Working)
Full-Time 37 Hours per Week Fixed-Term Contract Until September 2027
25 Days Holiday Bank Holidays Birthday Off Enhanced Pension Private GP Access

Are you an organised and people-focused HR professional who thrives on creating exceptional employee experiences?

We are looking for an HR Coordinator & Onboarding Specialist to join a growing HR team and take ownership of the entire onboarding journey. This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in welcoming new employees, supporting managers, maintaining HR records, and helping to create a positive and engaging workplace culture.

If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, building relationships across a business, and ensuring every new starter has a seamless experience, we'd love to hear from you.

HR Coordinator & Onboarding Specialist (Fixed-Term Contract)

The Role

As the HR Coordinator & Onboarding Specialist, you will be responsible for coordinating all aspects of employee onboarding while providing essential HR administrative support and first-line guidance to employees and managers.

You'll become a trusted point of contact, ensuring HR processes run smoothly and helping to drive a positive employee experience throughout the business.

HR Coordinator & Onboarding Specialist (Fixed-Term Contract)

Key Responsibilities

Employee Onboarding
- Manage the end-to-end onboarding process for new employees
- Prepare offer letters, contracts, onboarding packs, and HR documentation
- Coordinate inductions, orientation programmes, and first-day arrangements
- Liaise with managers to ensure equipment, system access, and resources are in place
- Monitor onboarding checklists and ensure compliance requirements are completed on time
- Conduct onboarding follow-ups during probation periods
- Gather feedback from new starters and managers to enhance onboarding processes
- Support the delivery of company-wide HR induction programmes

HR Administration
- Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems
- Process employee changes including transfers, promotions, and leavers
- Support benefits administration and employee queries
- Provide information to support payroll processes
- Produce HR reports and documentation
- Manage employment verification requests and routine HR correspondence
- Ensure HR records are compliant and confidential

Employee & Manager Support
- Act as a first point of contact for HR-related queries
- Provide guidance on policies, procedures, and onboarding requirements
- Support employee engagement initiatives and internal communications
- Assist with training coordination, recognition programmes, and company events
- Help foster an inclusive and positive working environment

Compliance & Continuous Improvement
- Stay up to date with HR legislation and best practice
- Identify opportunities to improve HR processes and efficiencies
- Maintain documentation and records to support audits and reporting requirements

HR Coordinator & Onboarding Specialist (Fixed-Term Contract)

About You
- Level 3 CIPD qualification
- At least 3 years' experience within HR, onboarding, recruitment coordination, or HR administration
- Excellent organisational and time management skills
- Strong written and verbal communication abilities
- A high level of attention to detail and accuracy
- The ability to handle confidential information with discretion
- Experience using HR systems and applicant tracking platforms
- Good working knowledge of Google Workspace and SmartSheets

Thank you for your application. Due to the volume of applications, we receive, unfortunately we are not able to respond to every application personally, therefore, if you have not heard back from us within 5 working days, please assume your application has been unsuccessful. To see our other available vacancies please visit our website.

title: Payroll Operations Administrator
description:
Our OEM Client based in Solihull, is searching for a Payroll Operations Administrator to join their team, Inside IR35. This is a maternity cover contract position with a proposed end date of 30th September 2027.

Umbrella Pay Rate: £25.49 per hour.

Role Purpose:

Processing the Payroll Operations for the UK monthly and weekly payrolls for circa 30,000 employees, working collaboratively with the team and assisting with projects. Reporting to the Payroll Operations Supervisor, responsible for compliance of UK legislation and internal company policies. To assist in driving forward change and efficiencies to support business strategies.

Responsibilities:
- To process weekly and monthly payrolls as part of a large payroll team, ensuring successful BACS submission, working to strict, set and agreed deadlines.
- Completion of weekly/monthly RTI submissions.
- Perform manual payroll & Pension calculations.
- Have a thorough understanding of all aspects of payroll from start to finish.
- Keep up to date with current and future legislation.
- Understand and be able to process Early Year Updates when applicable.
- Completion of spreadsheet & understanding of monthly PAYE.
- Experience of salary sacrifice schemes Childcare , Pension and Cycle to Work etc
- Experience of Court Orders & Attachment of Earnings .
- Experience of all year-end requirements.
- Dealing with internal and external queries on all pay related queries.
- To assist in producing documented procedures for all payroll activities.
- Deliver accurate and compliant payroll processing for a variety of complex terms, conditions and shift patterns.
- Excellent customer service and ability to build relationships with key stakeholders.
- Support in identifying improvements and changes to payroll.
- Managing and maintaining clear and informative communication.
- Help & train colleagues and new starters when required.
- Support and participate in the Payroll Alignment Strategy and complete set Goals and Objectives.

Essential Skills, Experience and Knowledge Required:
- 2 years experience of working in a large multi-site Payroll Department.
- Excellent organisation and communication skills.
- Excellent customer service skills.
- Ability to work well under pressure.
- Ability to work as a Team Player .
- Working knowledge of Republic of Ireland payroll legislation and processes, including Pay-Related Social Insurance (PRSI) and USC (Universal Social Charge).

Desirable Skills, Experience and Knowledge Requested:
- Working towards a Payroll qualification would be an advantage.
- Knowledge of Resource Link would be an advantage.

Key Interactions:
- Finance.
- Human Resources.
- Reward & Pensions.
- IT.
- Manufacturing.
